title: Quantum Lifts of Noninteger Power Law Field Theories
summary: Field theories whose potentials have noninteger power laws $α$ have found many applications, but are often claimed to have no lift to quantum field theory except as effective models. We define quantum lifts by expanding the classical potential in Hermite polynomials and then normal ordering at a mass scale shifted by a parameter $β$. We find that when $α>2$, for sufficiently large $β$, the vacuum state can be perturbatively expanded in usual Fock states. We apply this to the following problem.
